name: tastemaker
title_zh: 把参考图变成同风格UI代码，告别AI味
tagline_zh: 粘贴Pinterest/Dribbble链接或图片，自动提取配色、字体、间距、质感，生成真正好看的界面。
tagline_en: Paste a Pinterest/Dribbble link or image, and get UI code that matches its palette, type, spacing, and vibe—no.
desc_en: Generate genuinely beautiful, on-brand UI instead of generic "AI slop" — use whenever the user asks to build, design, style, or improve a UI, landing page, dashboard, app screen, or component, whenever a PRD/spec needs a design pass before implementation, whenever the user pastes reference images/Pinterest/Dribbble links and wants the app to look like them, or whenever the user complains the AI-ge
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是从参考图里拆解视觉语言，再按你的组件结构重组。比“模仿某网站”更聪明。
why_en: It doesn't just copy a layout—it extracts the visual DNA (color, type, spacing, texture) and rebuilds it around your components.
